game_concept: A card battler set in Sand Dunes – Scorpion Canyon, a canyon of scorpions: the desert nomad must handle mirage spirits while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Algorithm Race: Choose the faster of two approaches (loop vs formula) to out-pace a rival process.
theme: Sand Dunes – Scorpion Canyon: a canyon of scorpions
core_gameplay_loop: In Scorpion Canyon, repeat each round: Choose the faster of two approaches (loop vs formula) to out-pace a rival process. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the speed value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Chain 10 consecutive correct decisions about speed to power up the desert nomad and open the water well.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 6 (applied tier): Algorithm Race
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Algorithm Race' (Week 9 slot 12), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Scorpion Canyon'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how speed changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against mirage spirits in Scorpion Canyon.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 10.
